recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組化（標記未標明）中，細胞豐富的背景裡只有散在的小型圓形細胞呈環狀膜/胞質棕色陽性，中央一個核較淡、細胞排列鬆散的區域（疑為肉芽腫）內外有較多陽性細胞聚集；本身無法看到組織漿菌，需配合 GMS/PAS 染色。
features: Hypercellular marrow core with hematoxylin-counterstained negative hematopoietic cells
Scattered small round cells with crisp ring-like membranous/cytoplasmic brown positivity
Loose central zone with paler, oval epithelioid-type nuclei, suggestive of a granuloma, with a small cluster of positive cells in and around it
Marker identity not provided; organisms are not visible on this stain
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on a hypercellular bone marrow core shows scattered positive small round cells with crisp ring-like membranous staining among negative hematopoietic elements. A central, loosely arranged area of pale oval epithelioid-appearing nuclei, suggestive of a granuloma, contains a small aggregate of positive cells at its periphery and within it. Because the marker is not stated, the positive cells cannot be definitively assigned to a lineage, and fungal organisms are not assessable on this preparation. The appearance is compatible with a lymphocyte subset accompanying a marrow granuloma in disseminated histoplasmosis; GMS or PAS stains and culture are required to demonstrate Histoplasma.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas look similar and are distinguished by acid-fast stain and culture/PCR rather than by immunophenotype of accompanying cells.
Sarcoid granulomas are well-formed, non-necrotizing and remain negative on GMS, PAS and acid-fast stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells within a mixed infiltrate and often fibrosis.
